name: MeetMind AI — Ultra-Fast Production Audio Pipeline (Adaptive Polling + Compact JSON)

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify((() => { const rawLang = String($('Normalize Binary & Start Timer').first().json?.body?.language || $('Normalize Binary & Start Timer').first().json?.language || 'auto').trim().toLowerCase(); const langCfg = rawLang === 'ar' || rawLang.startsWith('ar-') ? { language_code: 'ar' } : rawLang === 'en' || rawLang.startsWith('en-') ? { language_code: 'en' } : rawLang === 'mixed' ? { language_detection: true, language_detection_options: { code_switching: true } } : { language_detection: true }; return { audio_url: $json.upload_url, speech_models: ['assemblyai-stt-3-7', 'universal-2'], speaker_labels: true, punctuate: true, format_text: true, ...langCfg }; })()) }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { success: false, error: $json.error || 'AssemblyAI transcription failed or timed out' } }}
